items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1961-02-07
items.q: Placed with Andy Anderson. Yeah. Oh, that fellow, Toots. Yeah. That was just a four-piece band there.

ctx.x: In that band at that time was Rene. Mm-hmm. Well, by the name of Jack was playing tenor from Chicago. I was on a drum. Mm-hmm. And that fellow by the name of a piano player by the name of Toots. Uh-huh. I don't know if you know him. I can't think of his last name. I don't know his last name.

Remember his name, Dick? Toots. Is that the real bright down? Yeah. Where does he live? Up in Shrewsbury? Somewhere around that way, yeah. Toots Washington. Oh, yeah. That was a fellow, Toots Washington. Yeah. Placed with Andy Anderson. Yeah. Oh, that fellow, Toots. Yeah. That was just a four-piece band there.
Yeah. And when Toots left, they had Walter D. Coo played piano with us. Mm-hmm. To the place closed.
